job: Say how much a change will touch, before anyone commits it.
purpose: A tinted block that leads with a count in figures ("29 teams change"), one line on how they change, a short list of the largest with their before and after values, and "and 26 more" with a link to all. data-tone warns when the reach is wide. It is the result of a preview, or part of a case whose change reaches beyond one record.
useWhen: A change reaches more than the one thing on screen: a plan default, a crawl setting, a policy.
A preview must show its reach before the commit button appears.

avoidWhen.when: The change touches one record, which the brief already names.
A warning with no figure and no list.
Figures to read without a decision.

variants.useWhen: The reach is wide or the change is hard to take back.
The change removes access or data for those it touches.
A neutral reach worth knowing, such as a default for new teams only.

parts.role: The figure in bold and what it counts.
One line on how they change.
A few of them, each with an fd-delta or a figure.
How many more, and a link to the full list.
